entries.title: Claude Desktop v5.1231.0
entries.summary: Added run status to scheduled tasks that run on your computer, in Cowork and Code. A task's card can now say "Last run failed", "Last run failed, will try again", "Needs input" or "Didn't run", or why a run that is due hasn't started, such as "Waiting for its previous run to finish". Added "Allow for 30 days" to the prompt shown before a scheduled Cowork task deletes files in one of its own folders. Later runs can then delete there without asking. mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays sets the number of days, and 0 turns the option off. Added a warning when other Claude Code managed settings…
